name: Should I stain or paint the cabin interior?

mainEntity.name: Should I stain or paint the cabin interior?

acceptedAnswer.text: For Denver-area homes, interior staining is often compared with painting because climate, dryness, and sunlight can affect appearance and maintenance. If you want a natural wood look and the surface is in good condition, staining is usually the better choice; if the wood is heavily patched or mismatched, painting may be easier to uniformize.
acceptedAnswer.description: Choose staining if you want to keep the natural wood look and grain. Choose paint if the surface is heavily worn, mismatched, or you want a fully opaque finish that hides imperfections.
